questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Some of my courses were a little boring

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level was easier than in DK

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The same but all the exams in the same month

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
- Immunology
- Obesity
- Introduction to Norway
- Sustainable food production

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Immunology and obesity were both interesting
Introduction to Norway very easy and you don't have to attend the lectures.
Obs: If you speak Danish you can also chose courses in Norwegian and write your exams in danish. Maybe that would give more choises of courses.

questions.answer: Events at bars, bowling, trips to other parts of Norway

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Lofoten islands!!
Hike in the nature
skiing in the winter

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Very easy the culture is similar to the danish

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Appear at the events in the beginning of the semester, this is were I found my friends

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Not really, maybe it was a little hard understanding Norwegian in the beginning

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Being able to communicate both with the Norwegians and with other exchange students

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Buy hiking shoes
- Be a member of the sport assosiation of the university (NTNUI, SIT)
- Attend the events in the beginning of the semester

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: You can rent free outdoor geer at NTNUI boomerang

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Visiting Lofoten Islands. It is the most beutiful place

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: I lived at Singsaker Studenterheim together with 100 Norwegians. Sometimes it was a little challenging to understand them.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer:
Trondheim is a very cosy city with a nice student life. And it provide great opportunities for exploring the norwegian nature. 
I would really recommend it!!

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
